newsitem.title: USA: Key U.S. Republican says budget deal close.
newsitem.headline: Key U.S. Republican says budget deal close.

text.p: The White House and congressional budget negotiators will know "pretty soon" if there will be an agreement on a five-year balanced budget, Senate Budget Committee Chairman Pete Domenici told reporters Wednesday.
As he resumed talks with the White House, the New Mexico Republican said, "We'll know something pretty soon." Asked if there could be a budget agreement this week, Domenici replied, "Yes."
"Right now we are trying to exchange some information with the White House. It's pretty important information," he said.
"I am looking forward to meeting with you all very soon," Domenici said.
Two major issues that are outstanding involve annual and mandatory spending for new programs proposed by President Clinton, Domenici said.
The White House has said it will insist on new educational programs sought by Clinton to help post-secondary students and add to job-training programs.
